anchor: The Pitch Madison Advertising Report's ruled ₹-crore AdEx tables, set in the geometric sans of modernist advertising (Futura) on warm report stock, in the marigold-vermilion-peacock palette of Indian commercial print.
rationale: The corpus's intellectual signature is that one market is measured five ways (Madison legacy/expanded, dentsu, WPP, FICCI-EY) — a ledger whose columns disagree. So the world is a measurement-house report: ruled tables, ₹-crore figures in mono, geometric advertising type for the headings, on the cream stock of a printed annual. The palette is read off Indian commercial print and festive color (marigold gold, sindoor vermilion, peacock teal-blue, India-ink indigo, aubergine) rather than any Western adtech house style — deliberately the warm-editorial opposite of the cool monospace 'Dotted-Quad RFC' world of the adjacent IPv4/CTV corpus.

fonts.display: Futura, 'Century Gothic', 'Avenir Next', Avenir, 'Trebuchet MS', system-ui, sans-serif
fonts.body: Georgia, 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, 'Times New Roman', serif
